text:
marina: Heads-up — need final partner comms + legal clause sign-off for asia-southeast2 region launch with CloudScale & Nebula. Target announcement Wed Mar 27. Can we lock wording and embargo?

 diego: capacity side: partners confirmed initial 30 GPUs each for launch week, but marketplace quota needs approval — submitted ticket #PRJ-982. pinging @kait for customer-facing numbers.

 sasha: legal notes: please avoid product performance claims that imply SLA. Draft clause below — pls redline.

 sasha: ```Partner shall not represent Redwood Inference features beyond those explicitly documented. Press materials require mutual sign-off; 72h review window post draft submission.```

 anil: marketing timeline: draft due Mon Mar 18 -> partner review Tue Mar 19 -> legal sign-off Wed Mar 20 -> press embargo window opens Mon Mar 25 -> publish Wed Mar 27. Will produce 1-pager, joint blog, and 2 tweets.

 kait: field kit: need one-sheeter, two technical slides, and a partner FAQ. I'll draft the email template for sales ops. Do we have co-brand guidelines from CloudScale?

 diego: CloudScale sent logo/brand pack in S3: s3://partners/cloudscale/branding.zip link: https://redwood.internal/s3/cloudscale/branding.zip

 marina: @sasha can we shorten the review window to 48h for PR? Partners are on tight timelines.

 sasha: 48h ok with conditions: final deliverable must be in tracked doc, and at least one business day before embargo lift. Add this sentence to clause. I'll update.

 partner-bot: Draft marketplace listing created: https://console.redwood/marketplace/drafts/asia-southeast2-cloudscale-nebula — includes quota requested. (bot)

 anil: Example embargo paragraph for blog — feel free to copy:

 anil: ```EMBARGO: Please do not publish or share press materials concerning this announcement before 09:00 UTC on 2026-03-27. Redwood Inference and partner communications teams must approve changes within the review window.```

 marina: Action items: 1) @sasha update clause, 2) @anil final drafts by Mon 18, 3) @diego confirm quota ticket ETA, 4) @kait build field kit. I'll consolidate into a checklist and share with partners. :thumbsup:

 diego: noted, will chase quota team today and update ticket.

 kait: will start slide deck template, dropping link by EOD Fri.

 marina: thanks all — looping in partner PMs after legal draft. I'll post the consolidated checklist in morning sync.
